newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Bimantara says Q3 net 95.9 bln rph.
newsitem.headline: Bimantara says Q3 net 95.9 bln rph.

text.p: Indonesian conglomerate Bimantara Citra said on Friday it had posted a net profit of 95.9 billion rupiah in the third quarter of this year, up 18 percent from the same 1995 period.
The company said in a statement the media and broadcasting sector contributed 34 percent to its earnings, while the transporation and automotive sector contributed 23 percent.
It said the telecommunications sector accounted for 14 percent and the chemical sector eight percent.
The remainder came from various other sectors. The company issued the statement before its annual briefing for journalists. -- Jakarta newsroom + 6221 384-6364
